messages.content: "你能幫我做幾個任務嗎？首先，我需要計算7的階乘。然後，我想要買一支長笛。我偏好Yamaha，並且希望它有'開鍵式'和一個'銀笛頭'。最後，我正在進行一個遺傳學研究，需要計算在一個頻率為0.6的顯性等位基因的族群中，'AA'基因型的頻率。你能幫我處理這些嗎？"

So we need to call find_flute with brand=Yamaha, specs array containing "open hole", "silver headjoint". Possibly also include "C foot"? But spec param expects an array of strings from set {"open hole","C foot","silver headjoint"}[]. We can pass ["open hole","silver headjoint"].

3) Compute genotype frequency AA when allele freq p=0.6. Use Hardy-Weinberg principle: Frequency of AA = p^2 = 0.36.

We should use calculate_genotype_frequency with allele_frequency=0.6, genotype="AA".

Thus produce calls accordingly.

We'll output JSON or plain? According to guidelines, we should return tool invocation as separate messages. We'll do each separately.

First compute factorial via math_factorial( {number:7}). Then find flute via find_flute({brand:"Yamaha", specs:["open hole","silver headjoint"]}). Then calculate genotype frequency via calculate_genotype_frequency({allele_frequency:0.6, genotype:"AA"}).
